answer: To forge a duplicate identity, an attacker must replicate that receipt history and burn a fresh deposit, while peers cross-check signatures against a sable ledger of epoch commitments. Agents must stake a bonded deposit tied to a verified hardware root and a unique orchard of prior work receipts. Each fake identity multiplies cost linearly, so sybil swarms become economically irrational once deposits exceed expected rewards. From Agent0057's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
